subject: Invoice submission: multiple PO numbers in one PDF - acceptance & mapping
messages:
From: Peter Liu <peter.liu@acme-supplies.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@borealisinc.com
Date: 2025-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice submission - multiple PO numbers in one PDF

Hi Jasmine,

Quick question as we're getting set up in your vendor portal: some of our customers (and our ERP) batch invoices so a single PDF will contain multiple invoice pages that reference different Redwood PO numbers (one document, 2–4 PO numbers). Can you confirm whether you prefer: 1) us to upload that consolidated PDF to the portal as a single attachment and add PO numbers in the "PO" field (comma-separated), or 2) email the PDF to accounts@borealisinc.com with a subject line that lists the PO numbers?

Also — if we go the emailed-PDF route, what are the required fields you need extracted from the PDF for automated ingestion (we want to avoid manual processing)? A short skeleton example of the row mapping would be perfect.

Thanks,
Peter Liu
Senior Accounts Lead
Acme Supplies
[Attachment: sample_invoices_multi_po.pdf (PDF, 420KB)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Peter Liu <peter.liu@acme-supplies.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-10-11T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission - multiple PO numbers in one PDF

Hi Peter — thanks for the clear note and the sample. Short answer: portal-first, email allowed as an exception. Details below so your ops team can pick the cleanest path.

Portal (preferred)
- Upload a single PDF per invoice upload action. If one PDF contains multiple invoices/POs, please split into separate uploads when possible (one upload = one internal invoice row).
- If splitting upstream is not possible, the portal supports a single PDF with a comma-separated PO field. We will attempt automated split/extraction but it increases manual review rate.

Email fallback (acceptable with constraints)
- Send to accounts@borealisinc.com with subject: Redwood PO: <comma-separated POs> | Vendor invoice <your invoice#>
- PDF must have clear PO labels ("PO", "Purchase Order") adjacent to the numbers. Avoid handwritten PO scribbles.

Minimum extraction fields we require (for automated ingestion)
- vendor_name
- vendor_invoice_number
- invoice_date (ISO yyyy-mm-dd)
- line_items: each line should include description, qty, unit_price, line_total, and PO (if multiple, indicate which line maps to which PO)
- invoice_total (taxes and shipping broken out if present)
- payment_entity/GL entity (if relevant)

I've attached a very small CSV skeleton that our Ops team prefers for mapping. Vanessa / Karthik, can you confirm we can accept comma-separated POs in the portal and that the email fallback mapping below is sufficient for engineering to tune the extractor?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Vendor Onboarding Specialist | Redwood Inference

From: Peter Liu <peter.liu@acme-supplies.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@borealisinc.com
Date: 2025-10-13T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission - multiple PO numbers in one PDF

Thanks Jasmine — that helps. Attaching two examples: a single consolidated PDF (our current export) and a small CSV showing how our system currently emits line items. We can change our export to split into multiple PDFs if that will reduce review.

Questions:
1) If a single PDF contains two invoices that apply to two Redwood POs but the line items are mixed (one invoice header, then a table that contains lines for both POs), does Redwood prefer we add a simple "line-to-PO" mapping CSV next to the PDF? We can generate that.
2) Are you able to accept a single PDF + a companion CSV (same filename prefix) via the portal?

Sample attachments: sample_invoices_multi_po.pdf, extraction-row-skeleton.csv

—Peter
[Attachment: extraction-row-skeleton.csv (CSV, 3KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Liu <peter.liu@acme-supplies.com>
Date: 2025-10-14T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Invoice submission - multiple PO numbers in one PDF

Looping back — ops and infra reviewed the samples. Agreed policy proposal:
- Portal: accept single PDF + optional companion CSV (same prefix) for any edge-case multi-PO documents. The portal UI will show a "companion file" flag and ingest both together.
- Email fallback: accept PDF by email only when the vendor cannot change upstream exports; subject line must include comma-separated POs and vendor must CC accounts@borealisinc.com. Emailed PDFs without either a clear PO header or companion CSV will go to manual queue.

Required extractor adjustments (for engineering ticket)
- Prefer structured companion CSV if present (map CSV columns to ingestion fields).
- If only PDF is present, try keyed extraction: look for "PO" tokens and numeric sequences; if multiple POs found and no per-line mapping, route to review.

Vanessa — can you add a short item in the vendor onboarding form that asks: "Will you provide companion CSVs when PDFs contain multiple POs? (Y/N)" so Sales/Onboarding captures this during activation. I'll file an infra ticket with the above extractor rules and attach Peter's samples.

Karthik
Head of Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
